evals.prompt: We just copied launchpad last week for our team. Can you pull in the latest upstream changes? We haven't set up any upstream remote yet.
evals.expected_output: The skill should detect no upstream remote, ask the user for the upstream URL, add it, fetch latest, show what changed, protect teams/*.yml and CLAUDE.md, and merge cleanly.

assertions.name: checks_clean_working_tree
assertions.description: Runs git status --porcelain to verify clean working tree before proceeding

assertions.name: checks_upstream_remote
assertions.description: Checks if upstream remote exists and adds it if not

assertions.name: shows_changes_before_merge
assertions.description: Shows git log and/or diff stat of incoming changes before merging

assertions.name: asks_confirmation_before_merge
assertions.description: Uses AskUserQuestion to confirm before proceeding with the merge

assertions.name: uses_file_copy_strategy
assertions.description: Uses git checkout upstream/main -- <file> rather than git merge

assertions.name: protects_team_files
assertions.description: Preserves teams/*.yml and CLAUDE.md during sync

evals.prompt: Is my launchpad up to date with the main repo?
evals.expected_output: The skill should check upstream, fetch latest, and report that the repo is already up to date (or show what's new if not).

assertions.name: fetches_upstream
assertions.description: Runs git fetch upstream main to get latest state

assertions.name: compares_commits
assertions.description: Runs git log HEAD..upstream/main or similar to check for new commits

assertions.name: reports_status
assertions.description: Tells the user whether they are up to date or what changes are available

evals.prompt: Sync with upstream — I've been modifying some of the skill files locally and I know there might be conflicts with upstream changes.
evals.expected_output: The skill should handle the sync, auto-preserve protected files (teams/*.yml, CLAUDE.md) by keeping local versions, and interactively resolve any remaining conflicts in non-protected files.

assertions.name: checks_clean_working_tree
assertions.description: Verifies working tree is clean before proceeding

assertions.name: identifies_protected_files
assertions.description: Identifies teams/*.yml and CLAUDE.md as protected files before syncing

assertions.name: uses_file_copy_strategy
assertions.description: Uses git checkout upstream/main -- <file> rather than git merge

assertions.name: auto_preserves_protected_files
assertions.description: Skips protected files entirely rather than overwriting them

assertions.name: interactive_review_for_reviewable_files
assertions.description: For reviewable files (CLAUDE.md), shows diff and offers resolution options via AskUserQuestion
